message: 疾風のごとく（笑）

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, he's strong...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And it's five-on-one against him too~~」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it...! I figured you were just ordinary humans and went a little too easy on you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now's our only chance to corner him!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't push yourselves! He can still move...!」

name: Arden
message: 「I'll let you off with this for today. Next time, though, I won't be holding back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Arden!」

name: Arden
message: 「I've memorized your face, at least. Later!」
He bolted away as swift as the wind.
Everyone undid their transformations and let out a sigh of relief.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haaah... Looks like we managed to pull off a win, somehow.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, that makes the Delicious Food Squad look cute by comparison.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, I think it was a good wake-up call for us.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This means...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This means special training is our only option now!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's toast Mr. Arden to a crisp, flat pancake♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Though first, maybe a little snack...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm in!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, I suppose there's no harm in savoring the sweet taste of victory just a little!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. You guys are hopeless.」
That night, I raised a toast of tea with everyone.
